claim_boundary: Finite-domain black-box search, not a proof of global optimality. Cost is paid asset capital only, not social welfare or full transition cost. Annual reliability is an aggregate surrogate; selected candidates require separate hourly checks. No free GDP, efficiency, technological cost decline, installed capture or retirement changes are optimized.
structural_bound: Under the fixed useful-service/GDP/industrial mapping, national industrial CO2 at 2060 minus fixed sink is an unavoidable net-emission floor, since energy CO2 is nonnegative and no industry-abatement/removal decision is available. Targets below this floor are structurally infeasible in this declared domain.
annual_model: v5_annual origin_anchored; all candidates newly executed
fixed_evaluation_design: 4 explicit +256 Sobol +5*440 DE requests (maxiter10 popsize4 dimensionality10) =2460 unique candidates unless exact duplicates occur, separately counted; same declared bounds/seed as V4, no early convergence stopping.
